description: Return the parent chain for a taxon — from kingdom (or domain) down to the immediate parent of the queried taxon — as an ordered array. Each entry has its rank, canonical name, taxon usage key, checklist, and backbone mapping. The array is returned root-first (kingdom → phylum → class → … → immediate parent of the queried taxon); the queried taxon itself is not included — call gbif_get_species for its own record. The chain is read in the queried taxon's own checklist: datasetKey names it, each key is a taxon usage key there, and nubKey is the mapped backbone key the occurrence tools take, absent where the backbone has no mapping. Useful for building taxonomic trees or understanding placement without walking the checklist level by level.

taxonKey.description: GBIF taxon key: a backbone key from gbif_match_species, or a taxon usage key of any checklist, such as key from gbif_search_species.

name: gbif_get_species_classification

classification.description: Classification chain ordered from root (kingdom) to the immediate parent of the queried taxon. The queried taxon itself is not included — call gbif_get_species for its own record.

items.description: A single rank entry in the classification chain.

datasetKey.description: Source checklist dataset UUID, when GBIF supplies it.

key.description: Taxon usage key within the source checklist; not necessarily a backbone key.

nubKey.description: Mapped backbone taxon key for occurrence queries, when GBIF supplies it. Otherwise resolve the name with gbif_match_species.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No GBIF checklist has a taxon usage with this taxonKey. `invalid_filter`: GBIF rejected the taxonKey as unparseable — a value outside the 32-bit signed integer range. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the chain is empty because the taxon sits at the root of its checklist. Absent when the chain has entries.

title: Get Species Classification
